summary: Diagnosed svelte-check errors in the apps/app, then rewrote CommandPalette.svelte to drop the unused integrations parameter and full-rewrote WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte around a new per-workspace extensions/skills overrides model. Ran the agent-server test suite, confirmed 17 failures pre-exist via stash, and fixed the 6 failures caused by the changes by updating project-catalog, resource-catalog, and registry tests and by sharing GlobalResourceStore's dataDir with ProjectCatalog.
decisions: CommandPalette.onSelectWorkspace signature simplified to (projectPath: string) => void; the workspace no longer returns integrations from store.addProject, and the second arg was removed to match the new model.
store.addProject is now called with a single argument (selectedPath); the empty-arrays second argument and project.integrations lookup were removed.
ProjectCatalog now constructs its default GlobalResourceStore with the same dataDir as the catalog, so the global disabled set and the catalog see the same resources.json on disk.
Legacy ProjectCatalog.list() entries are expected to inherit global extension state rather than carry empty integrations; the legacy test was rewritten to assert [{ id: 'svelte', root: '.' }].
17 agent-server test failures (run-script, session-repository, pi-runtime-config, extension-resources) were verified to pre-exist on the unmodified tree via git stash and treated as out of scope.

WorkspaceConfigurePanel was rebuilt from scratch (13,348 bytes) around ProjectConfig/ProjectDomains with skill override toggles, an explicit 'Not installed' section, a remove-workspace confirmation, and per-extension Switch controls reading store.globalGizmoExtensions / store.globalPiExtensions.
errors: svelte-check reported 36 errors across 3 files, including missing exports WorkspaceProfile/WorkspaceProfiles from @gizmo/protocol, missing './profile-overrides' module, and a CommandPalette.svelte call passing two arguments to store.addProject.

WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte rewrite initially had invalid syntax: typo 'untrack$', invalid `function piExtensions = $derived(...)` (should be `let`), unused ProjectSkill/SkillResource imports, and `activeSkills` referencing the removed `skills` variable instead of `installedSkills`.

project-catalog.test.ts: 'resolves overrides against the global disabled set' and 'registers legacy projects without deriving extensions from them' failed because GlobalResourceStore defaulted to defaultDataDir() rather than the test data dir; fixed by passing dataDir to GlobalResourceStore and updating the legacy expectations to include the globally-registered svelte integration.
registry.test.ts: 'lists every globally installed extension without inspecting the workspace' failed with `installedExtensionCatalog is not a function` (test referenced a renamed export).
resource-catalog.test.ts: 'installs discovered skills globally but leaves them disabled' failed because the skill ended up installed=false instead of true.
